name: Agent cards show each agent's linked-skill count from the API
description: Read-only: the Agents page and the agent editor's agent list both show each seeded agent's linked-skill count as returned by GET /agents (Test Quality Reviewer 4, API Contract Reviewer 3, the other reviewers 0). Nothing is linked, saved or reviewed, and no model is called.

cmd: (() => ['General Reviewer', 'Security Reviewer', 'Performance Reviewer', 'Test Quality Reviewer', 'API Contract Reviewer'].map((n) => { const del = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Delete agent ' + n + '"]'); const card = del && del.closest('div').parentElement; const m = card && card.innerText.match(/(\d+) skills?\b/); return n + '=' + (m ? m[1] : 'none'); }).join('|'))()

assert.stdoutIncludes: General Reviewer=0|Security Reviewer=0|Performance Reviewer=0|Test Quality Reviewer=4|API Contract Reviewer=3

steps.label: every agent card on the list shows its count
